title: Palindrome partitioning II
statement: Return the minimum number of cuts so that every piece of s is a palindrome.
hints: Precompute pal[i][j] (is s[i..j] a palindrome?) by interval DP.
cut[j] = min over palindromes s[i..j] of cut[i−1] + 1 (or 0 if i = 0).

solution.explanation: Two DPs stacked: an interval DP answers palindrome queries in O(1), then a prefix DP chooses the last piece. Without the table, checking each piece costs O(n) and the whole thing is O(n³).
